title: Octagon and dot floor tiles
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of the octagon and dot pattern: octagons on a square grid with small square dots at their corners, grout, bevels, glazed, terracotta or marble finishes with veins that break at the joints, and wear. Use for bathroom, kitchen and hallway floors and Victorian or classic interiors.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python octagon_dot_tiles.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: tiles_across
parameters.meaning: Octagons across the tile width (and height).

parameters.name: dot_size
parameters.meaning: Half-diagonal of each corner dot in octagon widths; larger dots cut deeper corners.

parameters.name: grout_depth
parameters.meaning: How far the grout sits below the tile faces.

parameters.name: bevel
parameters.meaning: Width of the rounded tile edge in octagon widths.

parameters.name: veining
parameters.meaning: Marble veins through the octagons (light) and dots (pale veins on dark stone).

parameters.name: wear
parameters.meaning: Scuffed, duller and lighter traffic patches and slightly worn edges.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: White glazed octagons with black dots and grey grout.

presets.name: terracotta_tozzetti
presets.description: Unglazed terracotta octagons with small dark green glazed dots.

presets.name: marble_classic
presets.description: Honed white marble octagons with black marble dots, thin joints, veins.

presets.name: small_mosaic
presets.description: Small matte white octagon mosaic with blue dots.

limits: Octagons are regular cuts of a square cell, so octagons and dots always align with the tile axes; borders, cut pieces and diagonal layouts are out of scope. Marble veins are isolines of warped noise, an approximation of real stone, read at a random offset per piece. Lippage between pieces is a small random height offset. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Octagon as the intersection of a square and a 45 degree square
Corner dots as the complement of four cut corners
Signed distance from side and diagonal half-planes
Isoline distance of warped fractional Brownian motion for marble veins
Per-piece hashing for colour, lippage and vein offset
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
